title: Road traffic counts (hourly)
summary: Hourly vehicle counts from road counters near the monitoring stations in Valdena, covering from 2021-01-01 to present (still updating hourly). Each row records one counter at one hour with the total vehicle count. The data is accessed via warehouse SQL through a request to the Mobility Office. A critical data quality issue is that road counters were replaced on 2024-03-18, changing from per-direction recording to combined directions, so counts cannot be directly compared across that break without adjustment. No sensor location metadata is included in this dataset — a separate asset register would be needed to map counters to air quality stations spatially.

schema.notes: Catalog lists three columns. No counter_id reference table or location data in this dataset. Direction field was removed after the 2024-03-18 counter replacement, but this is not reflected in the schema.

spatial.notes: The counters are described as 'near the monitoring stations' in Valdena (northern Italy). The data does not contain any location columns (latitude, longitude, address). A separate asset register would be needed to map counter_id to coordinates.

documentation_excerpts: Vehicles counted per hour by road counters near the monitoring stations. (catalog description)

On 2024-03-18 the road counters were replaced. Before that date, counts were recorded per direction. From 2024-03-18, counts are both directions combined. Do not compare counts across the change without adjusting for it. (wiki page 'counter_replacement_2024', last edited 2024-04-02)
quality_notes: Counter replacement on 2024-03-18 changed direction recording: per-direction before, combined after (wiki page 'counter_replacement_2024', last edited 2024-04-02).
Catalog entry has no note about the 2024-03-18 counter replacement, creating a discrepancy between catalog and wiki documentation.
No sensor location metadata (coordinates, address) in the catalog entry or table schema — cannot match counters to air quality stations without a separate asset register.
The catalog lists 3 columns, but the wiki notes that the direction column (which existed before the counter replacement) is not documented in the catalog at all.
